verdict.calibration_caveat: The KS p-value is reported as a descriptive threshold, not as a significance test: an evaluation rollout's appraisals are not independent (50 share a state within an iteration, and consecutive iterations share a landscape), so the effective sample size is far below the nominal one and a p-value computed as if the sample were i.i.d. is anti-conservative at these sizes.  Read the KS statistic, which is an effect size, rather than the p-value beside it.
verdict.statement: Across 12 cell(s) scored against `tail_return`, CRPS skill against climatology averages -7.0778 (SD 1.5878, SE 0.4584); no cell beat(s) climatology, so no cell's distribution carries more information than the run's own marginal histogram of returns.  CRPS skill against the network at initialisation averages +0.4332 (SD 0.0369).  0 of 12 cell(s) have a randomised PIT consistent with uniformity, 12 of 12 hold the distribution inside the atom support, and 12 of 12 have an atom spacing fine enough to express the realised variation.
